_comment: Reviewed field aliases for the search data files (#158, owner decision Q3; D6, D6a). A field is a name plus a zip: each entry merges the complex names listed in `aliases` (in search_data.norm_name form) at that zip into one field called `name`, shown as `label`. Aliases apply only at their zip. search_data.py validates every entry; a bad one is left out, reported, and fails `python archive.py --search-data --check`. Same-zip candidates are listed in the build report and are never merged automatically.

fields.name: Great Park
fields.label: Orange County Great Park
aliases: orange county great park sports park
fields.evidence: Owner decisions D6 and D6a (#156): the 12 complex IDs 80, 422, 1018, 2555, 2838, 3069, 3075, 3416, 4559, 6698, 7083 and 7319 all sit at 92618 under these four names; 3069 (Orange County Great Park Sports Park) plays on Field 17, which the other Great Park IDs also use.
